title: Single Cell Dissociation of Fresh Lung Tissue
author: Lance Peter
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7xkhpkw
materials: 10X Genomics Chromium Single Cell 5' Library Kit
Generate cDNA and library following the kit protocol.

steps.title: Prepare and Mince Lung Tissue
steps.instruction: Prepare the distal lung tissue for dissociation.

substeps.instruction: Transfer distal lung tissue to a cold petri dish and dissect into required pieces.
Blot one piece of tissue (2cm³) dry on a disposable underpad and place it in another cold petri dish.
Mince the tissue into smaller pieces using a scalpel.

steps.title: Enzymatic Dissociation
steps.instruction: Dissociate the minced tissue using the GentleMACS system.

substeps.instruction: Transfer minced tissue to a GentleMACS C tube containing 7 mL of 4 °C Enzyme Mix.
Process on GentleMACS Dissociator using program GM8.zip for 18 minutes at 37 °C.

steps.title: Inactivate and Filter Cells
steps.instruction: Stop the enzymatic reaction and filter the cell suspension.

substeps.instruction: Add 7 mL of 4 °C Inactivation Media.
Titrate the suspension 5-10 times using a 10 mL serological pipette at 2 mL/s.
Pass the cell suspension through a series of 100 μm and 30 μm strainers into a 15 mL falcon tube.
Centrifuge at 300g for 5 minutes at 4 °C.
Remove the supernatant.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 5 mL of 4 °C 1X PBS 3% BSA.
Count the cells and transfer 1 - 2 x 10^6 cells to a new 15 mL falcon tube.
Centrifuge at 300g for 5 minutes at 4 °C.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 1 mL of 4 °C 1X PBS 3% BSA.
Add 2 µL of 50 μM calcein AM to the cell suspension.

steps.title: Prepare Collection Tubes
steps.instruction: Prepare tubes for cell sorting according to 10X Genomics Chromium Single Cell 5' Library Kit guidelines.

substeps.instruction: Prepare cell collection tubes containing RT Reagent Mix, Poly-dT RT Primer, Additive A, and nuclease-free water.

steps.title: FACS Sort Live Cells
steps.instruction: Sort calcein AM positive cells into the prepared collection tubes.

substeps.instruction: Immediately after incubation, use a Sony SH800 (70 μm sorting chip) to sort 15,000 calcein AM positive cells into collection tubes at 4 °C.
Add 10 μl of RT Enzyme Mix B to the reaction mix and cell suspension to reach a total volume of 100 μl.
Incubate for 15 to 20 minutes at room temperature, protected from light.
Load Chromium chip A and run the Chromium controller for GEM generation.
